title: [DEV 3.0.0.1- E] After 51 minutes without bg values - TT was still on 0% and must be canceled manually.
symptom: After a Dexcom sensor failure, AAPS did not cancel its zero temp basal after 51 minutes without BG values, requiring manual cancellation. The user's BG rose to 210 during that time.
cause: OpenAPS is only invoked when a new glucose value arrives and can only be manually invoked for glucose values max 7 minutes old, so the code that limits zero temps to 30 minutes when BG is missing is not invoked, and the active temp runs until finished.
fix: No explicit fix provided; the thread suggests that with a failing sensor the user needs to take over control and take appropriate action.
evidence_quote: OpenAPS is only invoked when a new glucose value arrives and can manually be invoked only for glucose values max 7 minutes old. Hence the code mentioned above isn't invoked and the active temp runs until finished
